Sheet.InRollsHint: Use it in a roll formula: @Name is the current value, @Name_max the max (1d20 + @Strength). Only Latin letters, digits, _ and - are kept.
Sheet.NoAttributes: No attributes yet. Add the first one below.
Sheet.DescriptionSaveHint: Save: Ctrl+S or the disk button in the toolbar
Sheet.SendNotConnected: Sending items to the inventory is not connected yet.
Sheet.ResourceEnabled: This character has it (switched off: gone from the sheet, the panel and the token bar)
Sheet.ShowBarHint: Who sees this resource's bar above the token
Sheet.ShowValueHint: Who sees the number (current / max) on the bar

Footsteps.Hint: Footstep sounds while a token walks in this region. Every player hears them on their own; the volume falls off with the distance to their token.
Footsteps.NoMatches: The pattern {src} matched no sound files.

Audience.owner: The token's owner and the GM

src.label: Footstep sound
src.hint: One file, or a pattern with * - sounds/steps/grass-*.ogg, say: each step plays a random matching file.

interval.label: One step every (spaces)
interval.hint: How many grid spaces the token walks between two step sounds.

radius.label: Heard up to
radius.hint: In scene units. Steps further away are not heard, closer ones are louder. 0: heard the same everywhere.

audience.label: Who hears
audience.hint: Players never hear tokens the GM has hidden.

priority.label: Priority
priority.hint: Where footstep regions overlap, the one with the higher priority sounds.

Panel.Title: GM Panel
Panel.ResetFogConfirm: Reset the explored fog of war of this scene for every player?
Panel.NoLights: This scene has no light sources.
Panel.AttributeEditHint: Change values right here: 12 sets 12, -3 or +5 changes it by that much.
Panel.NoTokens: No other tokens on the scene.
Panel.BindingsHint: When the event happens, the sound plays and/or the macro runs. The second field narrows the event to one stat, attack type or character; empty means any. "Panel button" adds a button to "Quick sounds" (the second field is its name).
Panel.NoFootsteps: No footstep regions on this scene. Draw a region, open its configuration -> Behaviors -> "+" -> "Footsteps".
Panel.TemplateHint: Every new character and NPC starts with these attributes. Health, Mana and AP everyone has; they are not in this list.
Panel.TemplateApply: Add the missing ones to everyone
Panel.TemplateApplyConfirm: Give every existing actor the attributes of this list it does not have? Attributes it already has stay as they are.
Panel.RegionDrawHint: Draw the region on the map: it shows up in the list below at once.
Panel.RegionActive: On (a switched-off region is hidden and its behaviors do nothing)
Panel.NoRegions: This scene has no regions. Draw the first one with the buttons above.
Panel.NoSounds: This scene has no ambient sounds.
Panel.ViewAutoHint: Until you pick some, the attributes with a max are shown. This choice is yours: another GM has their own.
Panel.StatMacroHint: The sheet's "Roll" and "Reaction" buttons run these macros of the world. Edit them in Foundry's macro editor; players may run them but not change them. An unedited macro is brought up to date with the system.
Panel.StatMacroResetConfirm: Replace the text of the "{name}" macro with the system's original? Your changes to it will be lost.
Panel.BindingEmpty: This binding has neither a sound nor a macro: it does nothing.
Panel.OwnsNothing: This player owns no actor: they can change nothing. Pick a character for them above: they become its owner.

Macros.Updated: Macro "{name}" updated to the system's new version (you had not changed it).

Charges.RecoverHint: One recovery step: +1 to every recovering charge (for a fight without the combat tracker)
Charges.RecoveringHint: Recovering: +1 at the start of the character's turn; done / total

Log.Search: Search by character, player, attribute, reason
Log.ClearConfirm: Delete every log entry? This cannot be undone.
Log.Hint: Every change to attributes, health / mana / AP and charges: who, whose, before → after and why. The last 500 entries are kept.

Skills.Name: Name
Skills.Saved: Skill "{name}" saved. Characters who have it already keep their old copy.
Skills.ListHint: Skills are kept in the world compendium "Skills". Drag a skill onto a character sheet, or press "Give".
Skills.NoneYet: No skills yet. Create the first one above.
Skills.DeleteConfirm: Delete the skill {name} from the compendium? Characters keep their copies.
Skills.NoneOnSheet: No skills. The GM gives them from the GM panel or drops them on the sheet.
Skills.SheetHint: Cost, requirements and tags are changed on the GM panel -> Skills.
Skills.RollHint: Using the skill rolls this formula. Ticked, a window asks for a multiplier first, added to the roll. The formula can use attributes with Latin names: @Strength.
Skills.BadFormula: "{name}": the roll formula "{formula}" is not valid.
Skills.CooldownHint: How many of the character's turns the skill can't be used after use. In combat only; 0 for none.
